link.title: Theme Blocks
link.description: Theme blocks are how a 3D Bits configurator gets onto your storefront. Shopify themes are built from blocks a merchant can place and configure, and 3D Bits ships several: a full configurator, a lightweight preview for collection and gallery contexts, a standalone GUI controls block for custom layouts, and a legacy runner block kept for older setups. These pages cover what each block does, where it belongs in a theme, the app embed settings that apply across all of them, and the settings shared between blocks so you are not relearning them one at a time.
